visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A vertical close-up shot focuses on a small, rectangular pouch with a green base and white top, featuring Japanese text. A pair of hands meticulously unzips the top to reveal a beige plush rabbit with a green scarf nestled inside a transparent window. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene cuts to a man with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a brown beanie and a black jacket standing in a bright retail environment. He gestures towards a vibrant gashapon display board filled with images of colorful pouches. The background consists of blurred gashapon machines and store aisles. (3) A tight shot displays the gashapon machine's colorful signage, showcasing a green photo booth themed pouch priced at 500 yen. The graphic includes photos of the product and its features. The environment is well-lit with standard commercial overhead lights, creating clear visibility of the text and graphics. (4) The camera follows the man's hands as he inserts coins into the circular slot of a white gashapon machine. He turns the green plastic dial with a firm motion, and a yellow translucent capsule rolls down into the bottom retrieval bin, indicating a successful transaction in a busy public space. (5) On a flat white surface, the man's hands open the yellow capsule, pulling out a tightly folded green object wrapped in thin plastic and several small instructional papers. The camera stays in a close-up framing distance, emphasizing the tactile experience of unboxing the small prize. (6) The man unfolds the green pouch, revealing it to be a miniature photo booth bag with a clear front window and a small carabiner attached to the top. He rotates the bag to show its different sides, highlighting the detailed print that mimics a real Japanese ID photo machine. (7) A beige plush rabbit toy is shown next to the pouch. The man's hands carefully try to slide the plushie through the zippered opening. The toy fits snugly into the transparent window, appearing slightly compressed but clearly visible. He adjusts the toy's ears and position with his fingers. (8) The man examines additional small parts, including a sky-blue rectangular card and a tiny ID photo showing a cartoon cat character. He flips the pouch to the back and slides the small ID photo into a dedicated transparent pocket, demonstrating the product's customization features. (9) A close-up shot of the instructional pamphlet shows small graphics and Japanese text explaining how to use the different parts of the photo booth pouch. The man's thumb points to specific diagrams as he narrates, his hands keeping the paper steady for the camera. (10) The man holds the finished photo booth pouch with the plush rabbit inside, positioning it in front of his chest. He smiles warmly towards the camera, presenting the completed look of the item. The background remains the colorful rows of gashapon machines in the bright store.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Gentle, mid-tempo acoustic guitar music with a bright tone establishes a warm and friendly atmosphere. A clear, enthusiastic male voice introduces the item with a lively pitch. A sharp, mechanical zipper-opening sound is layered prominently as the visual focus shifts to the product reveal. (2) The narrator's speech remains energetic and articulate, maintaining a consistent moderate pace. The distinct metallic tinkling of coins being inserted into a machine is heard, followed by the heavy, rhythmic mechanical clicks and gear sounds of the gashapon dial rotating and the final hollow thud of a capsule. (3) The acoustic guitar BGM continues steadily in the background. High-frequency crinkling sounds of thin plastic wrap dominate the audio as the capsule's contents are extracted. The speaker lets out a soft, joyful laugh, signaling a high positive valence and a sense of discovery during the unboxing process. (4) Continuous rustling noises of varying textures—soft fabric and louder plastic—are heard as the pouch is manipulated and unfolded. The narrator's tone becomes more descriptive and informative, with clear pauses to emphasize specific features. A digital ding sound effect occasionally punctuates the audio during graphic overlays. (5) The sound of small pieces of paper being handled and shuffled is clearly audible. The speaker's voice remains dominant, explaining the various accessories included. More pronounced fabric rustling and muffled thuds occur as a plush toy is squeezed into the small pouch, ending with a cheerful final summary.
